paper_title: Flexible High-Performance and Solution-Processed Organic Photovoltaics with Robust Mechanical Stability
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2021 - Sun - Flexible High‐Performance and Solution‐Processed Organic Photovoltaics with Robust/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2021 - Sun - Flexible High‐Performance and Solution‐Processed Organic Photovoltaics with Robust.md

knowledge_points.content: FlexAgNE is a flexible transparent electrode (FTE) composed of a silver nanowire (AgNW) network modified with the hydrophilic polyelectrolyte poly(sodium 4-styrenesulfonate) (PSSNa) to achieve high conductivity, transparency, and mechanical stability.
knowledge_points.evidence: utilizing an ionic electrostatic charge repulsion strategy via introducing a polyelectrolyte into an AgNWs-water suspension, we have reported a high-quality FTE (called FlexAgNE)

knowledge_points.content: Flexible single-junction OPV devices based on the PM6:BTP-4F-12 active layer and FlexAgNE electrode achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 15.60%, with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.837 V, short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 24.92 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 74.8%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the flexible single-junction devices based on PM6:BTP-4F-12 offered a high PCE of 15.60% with open circuit voltage (Voc), short circuit current density (Jsc), and fill factor (FF) of 0.837 V, 24.92 mA cm⁻², and 74.8%, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Large-area flexible OPV devices with an active area of 1 cm² based on the PM6:BTP-4F-12 system achieved a PCE of 12.86%, representing one of the highest reported efficiencies for large-area flexible organic solar cells at the time of publication.
knowledge_points.evidence: Note such a large-area flexible device based on PM6:BTP-4F-12 yields an outstanding PCE of 12.86%, which is the highest PCE reported for large-area flexible OPVs so far.

knowledge_points.content: The work function of the FlexAgNE/ZnO electrode stack is measured at -4.33 eV, which is nearly identical to the -4.30 eV work function of conventional ITO/ZnO, ensuring efficient charge carrier injection and collection.
knowledge_points.evidence: the work function of FlexAgNE/ZnO (-4.33 eV) is comparable to that of ITO/ZnO (-4.30 eV), indicating that the charge carriers could be injected equally into FlexAgNE/ZnO and ITO/ZnO

knowledge_points.content: The mechanical adhesion of the FlexAgNE electrode to the polyethylene terephthalate (PET) substrate is enhanced by hydrogen bonding and van der Waals interactions between the sulfonic groups of the PSSNa polyelectrolyte and the hydroxyl groups of the ozone-treated PET.
knowledge_points.evidence: the hydrogen bond and van der Waals bond would form between the ozone-treated PET substrate and the hydrophilic polyelectrolyte (PSSNa). The binding force was generated from the interactions between sulfonic groups of PSSNa and hydroxyl groups of ozone-treated PET.

knowledge_points.content: The synergistic effect of capillary forces at crossed AgNW junctions and the tight filling of ZnO nanoparticles into the grid-like AgNW network voids leads to strong bonding between the AgNWs and the substrate, mitigating the fragility of the brittle ZnO layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: the capillary force effect of the crossed AgNWs junction and tight filling of ZnO in the grid-like AgNWs network leads to a strong bonding of AgNWs to substrate, which also reduces the impact of brittle ZnO on flexibility.

knowledge_points.content: Flexible OPV devices utilizing FlexAgNE electrodes maintained 91% (inward) and 93% (outward) of their initial PCE after 1000 continuous bending cycles at a radius of 3 mm.
knowledge_points.evidence: PCEs retention of 91% and 93% were achieved in inward and outward bending directions, respectively... After total continuous 1000 bending cycles... at a radius of 3 mm.

knowledge_points.content: Adhesion testing using mechanical scratching showed that FlexAgNE/ZnO stacks have superior adhesion (Level 1) compared to PET/AgNWs, with the adhesion force increasing from 0.02 mN for PET/AgNWs to 0.1 mN for PET/FlexAgNE.
knowledge_points.evidence: PET/AgNWs has a relatively low adhesion force of 0.02 mN whereas the force for PET/FlexAgNE was dramatically increased to 0.1 mN. ... the FlexAgNE and FlexAgNE/ZnO stacks were rated as level 1

knowledge_points.content: The slight degradation in efficiency observed after extreme bending cycles is primarily attributed to geometrical cracks forming in the top silver (Ag) electrode, rather than failure of the FlexAgNE bottom electrode or the ZnO transport layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: the slightly degraded OPV performance after bending for the flexible devices... is probably due to the geometrical cracks (defects) of top Ag electrodes, not from the FlexAgNE or FlexAgNE/ZnO layers.

knowledge_points.content: FlexAgNE electrodes are produced via a simple one-step water solution process, offering a simplified and cost-effective alternative to multi-step electrode fabrication methods like film transferring or UV-curing resin embedding.
knowledge_points.evidence: explore whether our FlexAgNEs, available with an easy one-step water solution process, can be successfully applied with the new and efficient Y6... to simplify the process

knowledge_points.content: Flexible OPV devices based on FlexAgNE show high long-term shelf stability, retaining more than 95% of their initial PCE after storage for over 170 days.
knowledge_points.evidence: all the tested flexible devices show rather high stability and small degradations, with < 5% of their initial values in terms of PCEs after testing over 170 days.

knowledge_points.content: Ternary flexible OPV devices using the PM6:Y6:PC61BM blend on FlexAgNE electrodes achieved a maximum PCE of 15.40%, with a Voc of 0.837 V, Jsc of 24.70 mA cm⁻², and FF of 74.5%.
